title: Abyssals v0.90.26 — Rivet’s Complete Armoury
notes: Adds twelve approved Rivet evolution branches and 24 battle sprites, completing pure Steel and all 17 Steel pairings. Twelve matching cores join the free bell-restoration choices and Thomas’s repeatable 10,000-doubloon shop; Rivet uses cores at level 12, followed by branch-specific level evolutions. Adds balanced stats/growth, learnsets, twelve final signatures, Carillodon’s sound-based Resonant Chime, physical Psychic Aesirion, dex and follower art, family-consistent shinies and complete offline assets. Existing species IDs, six original branches, Warbond, saves and quest progress remain intact.
